newsitem.title: GERMANY: Brazil airline VASP names German cargo manager.
newsitem.headline: Brazil airline VASP names German cargo manager.

text.p: Brazilian carrier VASP has appointed its own cargo sales manager Germany effective April 1.
Ishaq Shaikh, who has acted as cargo sales and service manager since February, will take over the post officially from general sales agent, Fischer Consulting, on that date.
Shaikh told Reuters in a telephone interview that VASP, which currently flies three times a week between Brazil and Germany, hoped to increase to five flights a week during the summer.
The private airline flies from Sao Paulo to Frankfurt, stopping in Rio on Wednesdays, Recife on Saturdays and Salvador on Sundays. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
